tokens.name: htl-night
tokens.usage: Brand Night. The darkest identity colour: page ground in the Night theme, ink in the Paper theme, text on Brass fills.

tokens.name: htl-deep-ink
tokens.usage: Brand Deep Ink. Panels, cards, the app-icon tile and the browser theme colour. Never the page ground.

tokens.name: htl-brass
tokens.usage: Brand Brass Gold, the single accent. Fills, the logo tip and accent marks on dark grounds. On Paper it is a fill only, never text (2.9:1).

tokens.name: htl-brass-deep
tokens.usage: Brass on light grounds: accent text, links and the logo tip on Paper (4.95:1 on htl-paper).

tokens.name: htl-paper
tokens.usage: Brand Paper. Page ground in the Paper theme; documents, proposals and print stock.

tokens.name: htl-slate
tokens.usage: Brand Slate. Secondary text on Paper and white.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background. Everything else sits on it.

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, pricing surfaces, menus and form fields.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hover and selected rows, and a panel inside a panel.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on surface-page, surface-panel and surface-raised in both themes (13.3:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, captions and mono labels on surface-page, surface-panel and surface-raised (6.6:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only. Carries no meaning, so it may sit below 3:1.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and checkboxes. At least 3.2:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Accent text, links, active nav, icons that carry meaning. 4.67:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, the signal square, progress marks. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed fill. Text on it is on-accent (7.8:1).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-fill and accent-fill-hover (6.3:1). Never white.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring with a 2px offset. At least 4.6:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors and destructive confirmations only, always with a written message. 5.6:1 or better on every surface.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page: the hero heading. Desktop only; drops to display-l under 768px.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Hero heading on tablet and mobile; slide titles.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Sub-section headings, card titles on large panels.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Small headings, pull quotes, step names.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Custom applications, AI inside your workflows, and engineers who work alongside your team.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a hero or section heading.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We connect what is scattered and ship software that runs in production.
styles.usage: Default reading text on the site and in documents (11pt in print).

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Fixed prices where the work is fixed; honest scope where it is not.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Buttons, nav links, form labels, chips.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Image captions, helper text under fields. Use ink-muted.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Live-text wordmark in headers and footers when the SVG is not available. All caps, only for the company name.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section markers, eyebrows and system labels. Always uppercase (set text-transform: uppercase).

styles.name: bn-display
styles.usage: Bangla hero and slide headings. Bangla needs about 1.4× line height for its upper and lower marks.

styles.name: bn-body
styles.usage: Bangla reading text on offer pages and proposals.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Use space-5 and above between blocks, space-1 to space-4 inside components.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its field; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal gap; list item gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Field padding; small card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Grid gutter; card padding; mobile page margin.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large panel padding; gap between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between heading block and content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between unrelated blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Desktop page margin; section padding on tablet.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section padding on large desktop.

radius.note: Instrument is crisp. Marks and tiles are square; controls get a small radius.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: The logo, the signal square, section rules, images.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Status labels and tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, cards and media frames.

shadow.note: Borders, not shadows. Only floating layers get a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and dialogs only.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Rules, card borders, control borders.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between an element and its focus ring.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover colour changes and pressed states.

tokens.name: duration-ui
tokens.usage: Menus opening, icon nudges, tab changes.

tokens.name: duration-reveal
tokens.usage: Section rise-in and word reveal (matches the site's --motion-ms).

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Hero-scale transitions only.

tokens.name: ease-signature
tokens.usage: The house curve: quick start, long calm settle. Default for everything that moves.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Elements leaving the screen.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width on the site.

tokens.name: grid-columns
tokens.usage: Columns on desktop; 6 on tablet, 4 on mobile.

tokens.name: grid-gutter
tokens.usage: Gutter at every breakpoint.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length for reading text.
